hooks.command: node -e "const input=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8')); const cmd=(input.tool_input&&input.tool_input.command)||''; const blocked=[/git push --force/,/git push -f/,/git reset --hard/,/rm -rf \//,/DROP TABLE/i,/DELETE FROM.*WHERE 1/i]; const warn=[/appsettings\.json/,/\.env$/]; for(const r of blocked){if(r.test(cmd)){process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({decision:'block',reason:'Blocked dangerous command: '+cmd}));process.exit(0);}} for(const r of warn){if(r.test(cmd)){process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({decision:'warn',reason:'Sensitive file/command detected - confirm: '+cmd}));process.exit(0);}} process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({decision:'approve'}));" 2>/dev/null || true

PreToolUse.description: Block destructive Bash commands (force push, hard reset, dangerous deletes)

hooks.command: node -e "const input=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8')); const path=(input.tool_input&&(input.tool_input.file_path||input.tool_input.path))||''; const sensitive=[/appsettings\.json$/,/\.env$/,/secrets\./i]; for(const r of sensitive){if(r.test(path)){process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({decision:'warn',reason:'Writing to sensitive config: '+path+' - verify no secrets are hardcoded'}));process.exit(0);}} process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({decision:'approve'}));" 2>/dev/null || true

PreToolUse.description: Warn when writing to sensitive config files (appsettings.json, .env)
